instruction.text: Select all the punctuation marks used to end a sentence.

atoms.b: We use ((++full_stops question_marks)) to end declarative sentences that make statements.
We use ((++question_marks exclamation_marks)) to end interrogative sentences that ask questions.
We use ((++exclamation_marks full_stops)) to end exclamatory sentences that express strong feelings.
We use ((++full_stops_or_exclamation_marks full_stops_or_question_marks)) to end imperative sentences to tell someone to do something.

instruction.text: Drag and match the sentence type to its correct end punctuation.
Drag the correct end punctuation to complete the sentence.

atoms.b: The ocean covers more than 70% of Earth’s surface((? ++. !))
atoms.sound: The ocean covers more than 70% of Earth’s surface.

atoms.b: How did you know it was my birthday yesterday((++? . !))
atoms.sound: How did you know it was my birthday yesterday?

atoms.b: There is a town named Great Snoring in Norfolk((? ++. !))
atoms.sound: There is a town named Great Snoring in Norfolk.

atoms.b: Could you stop speaking so loudly((++? . !))
atoms.sound: Could you stop speaking so loudly?
